cohort: 568 patients with a history of one previous cesarean delivery who attempted VBAC between January 1, 2014 and January 31, 2015 at Bahrain Defence Force Hospital.
finding: Previous vaginal birth, advanced cervical dilation, induction of labor, and a proper interval after cesarean section were associated with an increased success rate of VBAC, while recurrent indication for previous cesarean and maternal diabetes negatively affected the success rate.
